## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}
x_value=cars$speed
x<-matrix(x_value,nrow=50,ncol=1)
y_value=cars$dist
y<-matrix(y_value,nrow=50,ncol=1)
x_trans=t(x)               #finding transporse of x
d= x_trans %*% x           #finding matrix multiplication 

M <- matrix(1,nrow=50,ncol=1)
Mx <- cbind(M,x)
e<- solve(t(Mx)%*%Mx)%*%(t(Mx)%*%y)

```
